description: Search 8.5 million academic papers (arXiv + biomedical: PMC / bioRxiv / medRxiv, all disciplines) by topic, keyword, author, or linked entity (gene / protein / disease). Each hit returns id, title, TLDR, type, and links. Use to find papers about a topic, e.g. 'transformer efficiency' or 'CRISPR base editing'.

date_max.description: Latest publication date, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). Use for a knowledge cutoff.

query.description: Natural-language search query. E.g. 'transformer attention efficiency', 'graph neural networks for molecular property prediction'.

name: search_papers
